### Growing in Knowledge of God
Author: Kristen Terrette
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wholly-loved/growing-in-knowledge-of-god-wholly-loved-april-27.html
Passage: Colossians 1:10
Points:
- Biblical knowledge must be paired with action rather than remaining mere intellectual information.
- Believers come to know God intimately by experiencing and practicing His truth each day.
- Living a life worthy of Christ involves remaining close to Him and displaying spiritual fruit.
- Applying Scripture in loving service opens our eyes to God's presence and work around us.

### Great Impression
Author: Linda Vujnov
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/homeword-april-20-2017.html
Passage: Colossians 1:10
Points:
- People are easily captivated by flashy spectacles, but God looks for humble obedience.
- Simple, unassuming acts of faith and sacrifice bring genuine pleasure to the Lord.
- Faithful service pleases God most when done quietly without seeking human recognition.
- Letting go of the desire to impress others brings lasting spiritual peace.
